decisions.reason: As the flagship featured on the home page, with growing cloud messaging demand, this option is still unfolding and its value is likely high, so the firm should keep it and commit further.
A dedicated page shows real commitment, and document workflows are central to the firm's direction, so uncertainty is still unresolved and keeping the service costs little relative to its upside.
The conversion service builds on the firm's existing messaging infrastructure, so keeping it costs little and preserves value for regulated customers who still rely on fax.
This feature sits close to the core fax offering and costs almost nothing to maintain, so there is no evidence yet that would justify abandoning it.
Sandbox threat protection fits growing security demand and the firm's security positioning, so keeping this option open is worthwhile while its prospects resolve.
Multi-engine scanning is a low-cost extension of the existing email security service, so the option is cheap to hold even though it could later be bundled into other security offerings.
